rule_smoke_tests: starting Fighter has heavy armour proficiency
multiclass Fighter does not grant heavy armour
War Domain subclass can grant heavy armour after multiclass
default dual wield requires light weapons
Dual Wielder permits eligible non-light one-handed weapons
ranged offhand requires hand crossbow pair
Helldusk self-proficiency does not block casting
known_limitations: V8.2 requires the existing V7 assets/js modules in the same repository and must run over HTTP/GitHub Pages.
Built-in catalog contains 130 curated items; the full external game item dump is not bundled.
Complex conditional passives are preserved as conditionals unless a deterministic rule mapper exists.
